tools.name: list_handoff_requested_conversations
tools.description: List all HelpScout conversations currently tagged 'handoff-requested', with conversation ID, customer, subject, owner, and current mailbox.

tools.name: read_handoff_policy_sheet
tools.description: Open the Support Handoff Policy spreadsheet (ss_handoff) and read the routing worksheet (ws_routing) defining destination mailboxes and validity rules.

tools.name: lookup_routing_rules
tools.description: Look up the specific routing rule rows that apply to a given conversation category (billing, SSO/auth, API, feature request) from the policy sheet.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: Retrieve the list of available HelpScout mailboxes and their IDs to resolve routing destinations.

tools.name: evaluate_handoff_validity
tools.description: Evaluate each tagged conversation against the routing rules to determine the correct destination mailbox, or flag it as invalid/unmatched when no rule applies.

tools.name: draft_handoff_summary
tools.description: Compose a handoff summary for the manager listing each conversation, its proposed destination mailbox, the routing rule applied, and any invalid/unmatched flags, saved as a draft artifact for review.

tools.name: move_conversation_to_mailbox
tools.description: Move a HelpScout conversation to a different mailbox and update its routing/assignment in the live support system.

tools.name: send_customer_reply
tools.description: Send an email reply (via Gmail/HelpScout) to the customer on a conversation, including handoff notification or status updates.

tools.name: post_to_support_handoffs_channel
tools.description: Post a message to the #support-handoffs Slack channel notifying the team of a processed handoff, including affected customer and conversation names.

tools.name: read_team_announcements
tools.description: Read pinned announcements and reminders posted in the #support-handoffs channel for context.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels to confirm the correct notification channel name and ID.
